title: When replacing files, offer option to move the item where the click was released.
line: When a dropped file replaces one with the same name on the desktop, it now appears where you dropped it.
explanation: Folder View places dropped files by remembering the drop position per file name and applying it when the new item is inserted into the model. When the copy overwrites an existing file, the model only refreshes that item and never inserts a row, so the remembered position was never used and the icon stayed where the old file was. Now, when the copy job reports a finished file that already exists in this view, Folder View moves that item to the drop position immediately.

commits.message:
foldermodel: place a replaced file where it was dropped

Dropping a file over one with the same name kept the old icon's spot,
because the overwritten item is never inserted again and so the drop
position was never applied. Move the existing item there right away.

BUG: 517579

media.caption: Dragging report.txt from Dolphin to the right side of the desktop and choosing Overwrite: the icon stays in the top-left corner.
Same drag and Overwrite: the replaced icon moves to where it was dropped.
